programme.title: Brother Outlaw
programme.desc: Een man wordt valselijk beschuldigd van een bankoverval, waardoor zijn broer hem uit de gevangenis wil breken.

programme.title: Bad Man's River
programme.desc: Overvaller Roy King verliest zijn vrouw, Alicia, aan de revolutionaire Montero. Ondanks hun rivaliteit werken ze samen in een poging de Mexicaanse regering een miljoen dollar afhandig te maken.

programme.title: Twice a Judas
programme.desc: Luke Barrett ontwaakt in de woestijn met geheugenverlies en een geweer met 'Dingus'. In de saloon ontmoet hij een mysterieuze vreemdeling die zijn naam kent. Langzaam ontdekt Luke dat hij met zijn partner is ingehuurd om zijn broer Victor te doden. Terwijl herinneringen terugkomen, wachten hem grote keuzes.

programme.title: Hannie Caulder
programme.desc: Een plattelandsvrouw huurt een premiejager in om haar te leren omgaan met een pistool, zodat ze wraak kan nemen.

programme.title: Die blutigen Geier von Alaska
programme.desc: Alaska tijdens de goudkoorts: Bontjager Don Rutland wordt onterecht beschuldigd van roof en moord. Terwijl hij vecht om te overleven, wordt hij bedreigd door rovers en de meedogenloze natuur. Met adembenemende decors, spannende actie en een meeslepende soundtrack biedt deze avonturenfilm pure sensatie.

programme.title: Dig Your Grave Friend... Sabata's Coming
programme.desc: Na de Burgeroorlog keert Steve McGowan terug om wraak te nemen op Miller, de tirannieke tycoon die zijn vader liet vermoorden. In de gevangenis bundelt hij onverwacht de krachten met bandiet Pompero. Hun strijd wordt bemoeilijkt door Millers verloofde Helen, die hen gevangen neemt maar later besluit hen te helpen tegen haar corrupte toekomstige echtgenoot.

programme.title: The Ruthless Four
programme.desc: In Nevada vinden goudzoeker Sam Cooper en zijn partner goud. Maar Sam's hebzuchtige partner begint te schieten op Sam die zijn toevlucht zoekt in de goudmijn.

programme.title: Hellgate
programme.desc: Onterecht beschuldigd van spionage belandt een man in de beruchte Hellgate-gevangenis. Na een mislukte ontsnapping wacht hem eenzame opsluiting. Maar wanneer een dodelijke plaag uitbreekt, krijgt hij een onverwachte kans op verlossing. Zal hij overleven en zijn naam zuiveren?

programme.title: $100,000 for Ringo
programme.desc: Lee Barton komt aan in Rainbow Valley, waar men hem verwart met Ward Cluster, een man die stierf in de burgeroorlog. Bartons leven raakt verstrengeld met lokale conflicten, een moordzuchtige baas en een zoekgeraakte schat. Samen met een sheriff zoekt hij gerechtigheid en een toekomst met Ward’s zoon Sean.

programme.title: Shoot the Living and Pray for the Dead
programme.desc: Nadat Dan Hogan en zijn bende een bank hebben overvallen, huren ze een mysterieuze man in om hen over de Mexicaanse grens te leiden in ruil voor de helft van de buit.

programme.title: Against a Crooked Sky
programme.desc: Een eenzame schutter spoort de leden van een vogelvrije bende op die zijn vrienden hebben vermoord.

programme.title: Pancho Villa
programme.desc: Een verraad in een wapendeal zet de Mexicaanse revolutionair Pancho Villa ertoe aan een wapenopslagplaats van het Amerikaanse leger in Columbus, New Mexico, te overvallen.

programme.title: Custer of the West
programme.desc: George Armstrong Custer's liefde voor de heroïsche tradities van de Calvarie en zijn afkeer van de komst van de industrialisatie leidt hem naar zijn lot bij de Little Big Horn.

programme.title: No Killing Without Dollars
programme.desc: Lawrence White keert terug naar Owell Rock om de moord op zijn vader te wreken. Om zijn plannen te kunnen uitvoeren, verandert hij zijn naam en laat hij een andere man zich voordoen als "Lawrence White."

programme.title: The Man from Utah
programme.desc: In een paardrijdwedstrijd willen de slechteriken dat John Weston verliest. Wanneer hij niet meegaat voegen ze een verzekering toe: een vergiftigde naald onder zijn zadel.

programme.title: The Counterfeit Kid
programme.desc: Jack, een eenvoudige boerenknecht, moet hulp krijgen van een groep wilde buitenbeentjes en een schat vinden voordat de bandiet die hij imiteert hem vindt.

programme.title: Life is Tough, Eh Providence
programme.desc: Een excentrieke premiejager genaamd Providence vangt en bevrijdt een crimineel om steeds weer dezelfde premie te innen in verschillende staten, totdat ze ontdekken dat een plaatselijke sheriff iets niet pluis is.

programme.title: Comin' at Ya!
programme.desc: De broers Pike en Polk vallen een bruiloft aan, schieten de bruidegom neer en ontvoeren vrouwen om ze te verkopen. H. H. Hart overleeft en jaagt de broers op. Hij bevrijdt de vrouwen, maar wordt gevangen genomen, enkel overlevend dankzij zijn gevangene Polk.

programme.title: Dead are Countless
programme.desc: Als kind zag Johnny hoe soldaten zijn vader doodden. Getekend door wrok groeit hij uit tot een meedogenloze outlaw die elke soldaat neerhaalt die hij tegenkomt. Het leger stuurt luitenant Garringo eropuit om Johnny levend te arresteren, maar de jacht verandert al snel in een gevaarlijk spel van wraak en recht.

programme.title: Massacre
programme.desc: Een bende wapensmokkelaars wordt gezocht door zowel de Mexicaanse Rurales als de Yaqui-indianen. De Rurales willen voorkomen dat de indianen onschuldige boeren aanvallen, terwijl de indianen wraak willen nemen voor de valse medicijnen die hun kinderen blind maakten. De bende wordt gevangen, maar beiden worden omsingeld door de woedende indianen in een verlaten missie. Kunnen politie en criminelen samenwerken om te overleven?

programme.title: Deadly Trackers
programme.desc: Jeff wil elk van de vijf bandieten vermoorden die zijn arme zus hebben beroofd, verkracht en vermoord.

programme.title: Pistol for a Hundred Coffins
programme.desc: Returning from the Civil War, Jim Slade finds his parents murdered and blames Corbett’s gang. Seeking revenge, he takes a job as sheriff to fund his pursuit, only to discover the truth behind the crime is far more complex than he imagined.

programme.title: A Coffin for the Sheriff
programme.desc: Anthony Steffen speelt Shenandoah, een mysterieuze man die na een gevaarlijke inwijding aansluit bij een meedogenloze bende wegpiraat. Wanneer de groep hem verdenkt van verraad, ontdekken ze zijn ware motief: wraak. Een spannend verhaal over vertrouwen, geheimen en vergelding in het wilde westen.

programme.title: Santa Fe Trail
programme.desc: In 1854 worden Jeb Stuart, George Custer en andere afgestudeerden van West Point naar Kansas gestuurd om daar te helpen pacificeren voordat de aanleg van de spoorlijn naar Santa Fe kan worden hervat.

programme.title: White Fang
programme.desc: De wolfhond White Fang helpt een verslaggever, een pelsjager, een non, een jonge Eskimo-jongen en zijn vader om een goudmijnstadje te ontdoen van een slonzige misdaadbaron in het Canadese Yukon van 1896.

programme.title: Django Kill... If You Live, Shoot!
programme.desc: Verschillende facties vechten om gestolen goud in een surrealistische stad.

programme.title: Cry Blood Apache
programme.desc: Bende sadistische cowboys laten niets in hun weg staan in hun zoektocht naar goud.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: In 1876, Capt. Phillip Donlin hoort dat zijn vrouw, Celie, een affaire heeft met luitenant Haywood. Gebroken door de verraad vertrekt hij op een missie om generaal Custer te waarschuwen voor een grote Sioux-aanval bij Little Big Horn. Spanningen ontstaan tussen de troepen als Donlin zijn orders negeert om een heldhaftige waarschuwing te geven.

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: Na het beroven van een Mexicaanse bank, neemt pa Longworth de buit en laat zijn partner Rio achter om gevangen genomen te worden, maar Rio ontsnapt en gaat op zoek naar pa in Californië.

programme.title: Murieta!
programme.desc: De Mexicaanse boer Joaquin Murieta reist met zijn vrouw naar Californië op zoek naar goud, maar verliest alles aan wreedheid en racisme. Verteerd door verdriet vormt hij een bende om wraak te nemen, tot zijn eigen mannen hem verraden. Zijn lot bezegelt zich in een laatste, tragische confrontatie met de sheriff die hem ooit als vriend kende.

programme.title: Outlaw Women
programme.desc: In deze unieke 50's western wordt een stad beheerd door vrouwen, waar mannen niet welkom zijn. Een vrouwelijke outlaw, onder de indruk van de medische vaardigheden van een jonge arts, dwingt hem naar de stad te reizen, die wordt gedomineerd door een corrupte gokhal. De stad komt in gevaar door een bende outlaws en de verkiezing van een nieuwe marshal, waar de vrouwen niet aan mee mogen doen.

programme.title: Thunder at the Border
programme.desc: Winnetou en zijn zus Nscho-chi vluchten voor de bende van de Silers en vinden hulp bij pelsjagers onder leiding van Old Firehand. In Miramonte dreigt een aanval om een gevangengenomen bendelid te bevrijden. Terwijl Winnetou en Old Firehand helpen de stad te verdedigen, komt ook een verrassend familiegeheim aan het licht.

programme.title: Halleluja and Sartana Strike Again
programme.desc: Twee oplichters, waaronder een die zich voordoet als missionaris, proberen een kerkelijke groep te bedriegen. Maar in deze slapstick western raken ze verstrikt in de chaos van een gekke bende grondrovers. Humor, verwarring en avontuur volgen!

programme.title: The Tall Texan
programme.desc: Een groep reizigers reist door Comanche County op zoek naar goud op Indiase begraafplaatsen. De groep bestaat uit een cowboy en zijn vrouw, een sheriff met een moordenaar in bewaring, en een zeekapitein met een duister verleden. Nadat een renegaat hen vertelt over een goudveld, wordt hebzucht hun belangrijkste drijfveer.

programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: Oude Westernfilm met John Wayne: Angel and the Badman - Quirt Evans, een allround slechterik, wordt weer gezond gemaakt en gezocht door Penelope Worth, een Quaker-meisje. Uiteindelijk moet hij kiezen tussen zijn wereld en de wereld waarin Penelope leeft.

programme.title: Day of Anger
programme.desc: Bankoverval uitgevoerd door de bank ambtenaren, niet de gebruikelijke James bende.

programme.title: The Mercenary
programme.desc: Een inhalige Poolse huurling helpt een mijnwerker en een boerenmeisje bij het leiden van een revolutie tegen de onderdrukkende Mexicaanse regering, en wordt achtervolgd door een Amerikaanse rivaal.

programme.title: Bonanza Compilation Episodes 19, 20, 21
programme.desc: De Wild West-avonturen van Ben Cartwright en zijn zoons terwijl ze hun ranch in Nevada runnen en verdedigen terwijl ze de omringende gemeenschap helpen.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: Een bende die werkt voor The Shadow terroriseert de stad. John Travers besluit de baan van sheriff aan te nemen en er iets aan te doen.

programme.title: Bury Me Not
programme.desc: Twee vrouwen verbergen de verrassende waarheid terwijl een sheriff een moord onderzoekt.

programme.title: Apache Fury
programme.desc: Een rechter herkent tijdens een Apache-aanval een man die hij ooit onrecht aandeed. Samen met zijn verloofde en andere postkoetsreizigers zoekt hij toevlucht in een afgelegen rustplaats. Daar, omsingeld door dreiging van buiten én spanningen van binnen, wordt hij geconfronteerd met schuld, gevaar en onvermijdelijke keuzes.

programme.title: Taste of Killing
programme.desc: Dubieuze Bounty Killer Hank Fellows spoort bank postkoetsen op om te zien hoe ze worden beroofd.

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Who doesn't love Sweet Kisses? Join Chef Kimberly Lallouz as she showers them on her multi-course feast all laid out in One Big Recipe. Her Spicy Cornbread gets the first peck with lip-smacking Honey Butter. Then, it's a berry... nice smooch for a seared rare Duck Breast appetizer with Cherries and Walnuts. Avocado Honeydew Gazpacho follows, silky and savoury, with just a gentle sugary buss from the melon, it's a chilled soup gorgeously garnished with crostini and mascarpone. Citrus smooches Salmon on the main course, butter basted and presented with shattered dried citrus shards sprinkled over top and Basmati with Cranberries and Rice Vinegar alongside. Anyone can do it! It's all in the One Big Recipe.

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: What sets this cool One Big Recipe by charismatic chef-host Kimberly Lallouz apart? Folks, may I introduce the 'Wow Factor'? It's that hard- to-define special something, but we know it when we see it! Ogle her Chilled Mussels over Grilled Baguette lightly drizzled with vibrant, golden Saffron Aioli. Gasp at the golden gorgeous Roasted Mini Butternuts, ever so very vivacious with their Salsa Verde, tart Goat Cheese, and nutty toasted sunflower seed garnishes. Bone-in Veal Roast with an easy-to-execute and guaranteed-to-wow presentation is the apex of the event, with grainy mustard vinaigrette-dressed Charred Bok Choy halves. Dessert gets a moment in the spotlight, summer berries draped with applause-inspiring vanilla whipped cream and sweet, crunchy Macadamia Streusel.

programme.title: Pardon The Indigestion
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 Lobster Curry and More!
programme.desc: Enjoy a selection of recipes and food clips from Gusto TV, including Lobster Curry and more! Discover flavourful dishes, creative recipes, helpful cooking tips and plenty of inspiration for your next meal, with something delicious for every occasion.

programme.title: Pardon The Indigestion
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Jerk Lobster Tails with Grilled Pineapple Salsa and More!
programme.desc: Enjoy a selection of recipes and food clips from Gusto TV, including Jerk Lobster Tails with Grilled Pineapple Salsa and more! Discover flavourful dishes, creative recipes, helpful cooking tips and plenty of inspiration for your next meal, with something delicious for every occasion.

programme.title: Spencer's Holiday BBQ
programme.desc: Join charismatic chef Spencer Watts at his glorious rooftop patio for a one-hour special featuring a full holiday spread, all made on the BBQ. Spencer’s festive menu is all about creative BBQ twists with his delectable, mouth-watering recipes including Burnt Orange Cranberry Marmalade, Maple Rye Pumpkin Pie, and Asparagus with Smoked Salmon Dip. Save room for the piece de Q-sistance: Smoked Turkey Two Ways. This year, take your holiday feast outside and serve up something deliciously different.

programme.title: Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Get your 'Gobble Gobble' on with this special episode of Holiday Eatz, featuring fun and charming host Kimberly Lallouz! She starts her terrific Turkey Day menu with a harvest happy Kale Salad heaped with beets, candied pecans, toasted lentils, and goat cheese. Thanksgiving dinner needs Hot Rolls, Chef Lallouz packs hers with cranberries and corn, then serves them as a standalone course with a cheesy, creamy Mushroom Fondue! Next, it's time to talk turkey with a trick that cuts your poultry cooking time in half! Her Spatchcock Turkey is not just faster than old school, it's yummier too, with a garlic-herb marinade and a unique side of mixed beans and rice! Candied sweet potatoes and marshmallows make their perennial appearance here, but Chef Kimberly has a version that will fry"... your brain! Check out her Sweet Potato Churros with Marshmallow Creme for a presentation you"... do-nut"... want to miss!

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: In preparation for a relaxing holiday with friends and family, FLOUR POWER THANKSGIVING: PIES GALORE invites you into the kitchen to bring a twist to your Thanksgiving classics. In this holiday special, host Jessica McGovern takes us through three new and exciting treats to bring to your table, sharing some of her favourite tips and tricks along the way. Jessica offers up three alternatives to a standard Thanksgiving dessert - serving up light and flaky Pie Fries with Apple Caramel Dip, a rich and creamy Sweet Potato Pie, and a luscious Vanilla Bourbon Sweet Potato Pie Cake coated in a fluffy marshmallow frosting. These quick and easy recipes will put you in the holiday spirit while adding a new taste to classic desserts.

programme.title: BLITZ'N
programme.desc: Get ready for a special holiday BLITZ! with master mixologist Yvonne Langen as she prepares her favorite holiday cocktails and party snacks in the Gusto TV kitchen!

programme.title: The Wizard of Whatever: Holiday Edition
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The Wizard of Whatever: Holiday Edition
programme.desc: Gusto TV’s Wizard of Whatever, Chef Kyle Crawford, is dishing up a holiday feast! There’ll be food, fun, elves… and even jolly old St. Nick himself may make an appearance! Join in as Kyle cooks up a Christmas goose complete with stuffing and gravy, plus all the sides and salads, and even a flashy flambé dessert! Merry whatever!

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Twists on the Classics
programme.desc: Christmas is right around the corner and it calls for a little fun - like a twist on traditional holiday desserts! FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: TWISTS ON THE CLASSICS offers a new take on some of your favourites to bring you a fresh perspective and world of flavour for the holidays! Enchanting host Jessica McGovern plays off classic desserts, serving up handy hints on how to get the most out of every bite. From sweet and fluffy Gumdrop Cakes drizzled with a light lemony glaze to a delectable Eggnog Ski Slope Cake decorated with rosemary trees and a few friends to hit the hills, Jessica's unique holiday recipes will surly make it on your list of Christmas traditions!

programme.title: One World Kitchen: Our Favourite Holiday Recipes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 One World Kitchen: Our Favourite Holiday Recipes
programme.desc: In this special holiday episode of One World Kitchen, Hana (Japan), Vanessa (Italy), Natalia (Argentina), and Pailin (Thailand) get together to cook their favorite traditional holiday dishes influenced by their respective cultures. Christmas Sushi Rolls, Veal in a Creamy Tuna Sauce with Capers, Striped Bass in Garlic and Lime Marinade, and an epic Timballo. For the final recipe, our hosts combine all the flavors of One World Kitchen into a truly internationally-inspired turkey dish.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italian Christmas
programme.desc: BONACINI'S ITALIAN CHRISTMAS is a heartwarming one-hour holiday special featuring celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini as he shares some of his favourite Italian Christmas Eve dishes. Michael invites us to the set of his series "Bonacini's Italy" to cook up traditional Italian fare like Salt Cod Mousse on Polenta Crostini and Pork Braised in Milk. Michael takes us on a holiday culinary journey as he explores homey Christmas flavours and traditions, offering tips for perfecting dishes from the regions of Veneto, Sardinia, Calabria, Sicily, and Emilia Romagna.

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: The holidays are here! And the holidays come with a lineup of treats you won't be able to resist! From sweet and salty to traditional and unconventional, FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: BIG WOW DESSERTS covers it all. To get in the holiday spirit, enchanting host Jessica McGovern introduces two desserts that could impress any Scrooge. First, Jessica bakes a decadent Chocolate Yule Log stuffed with a creamy Salted Caramel Frosting and finishes with a holiday-inspired cake decorated with homemade peppermint candy canes! Interwoven with tricks of the trade, Jessica guides us through her simple yet inspiring treats that are perfect for a big Christmas celebration.

programme.title: Spencer's Big Holiday
programme.desc: No matter how you celebrate the holidays, let Spencer Watts help you plan the menu, in SPENCER’S BIG HOLIDAY! In this festive one-hour holiday special, Spencer Watts is serving up some of his favourite holiday meals, treats, and drinks. Follow Spencer as he shows us how to sail through the hectic holiday season with style, from brunch to the moment the clock strikes midnight.

programme.title: Maddie and Kiki's Holiday BBQ Barn
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Maddie and Kiki's Holiday BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Fun-loving sisters and expert grillmasters Maddie and Kiki welcome you into their country barn to celebrate the holidays! They’re making a full menu of festive dishes on the BBQ – plus some drinks to get you in the party mood!

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: Christmas is near, and the pressure is on! Between work, home, friends, and family, the list of people to buy for is endless. To help us through this busy time, FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: EDIBLE GIFTS offers up four creative and more personal options to make the holidays cheaper, sweeter, and filled with love. Fun host Jessica McGovern shows us how to bake something for everyone including Crispy Brittle Bark covered in chocolate, rich Coal Cookies that are sweet with a bit of heat, adorable peanut butter-chocolate Reindeer Cupcakes, and easy-to-make Christmas Puzzle Cookies.

programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc: The video captures a diverse range of musical performances, each with its own unique style and energy. Jesse Teasdale and Jade share their experiences running Golden Fries at Bluesfest Ottawa, highlighting the busy and memorable nights they have encountered. They discuss their popular menu items, including the classic poutine and crispy chicken poutine, and how they cater to large orders from artists and their crews. The video also features snippets of heartfelt and passionate lyrics from various songs, showcasing themes of love, longing, and personal reflection. Viewers will experience the dynamic atmosphere of Bluesfest Ottawa, the dedication of the Golden Fries team, and the emotional depth conveyed through the musical performances. This content offers a blend of culinary entrepreneurship, festival culture, and musical artistry.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Greek home cook Joanna Chery kicks off this episode of One World Kitchen by showcasing popular recipes from Athens. She begins by preparing Chicken Souvlaki with Tzatziki, a classic dish featuring succulent, beautifully charred chicken skewers and a refreshing cucumber yogurt garlic dipping sauce. Next, she fries up some deliciously flaky cod with an irresitble garlic-potato dip, a staple recipe for Greece's Independence Day. Another popular dish in the Greek culture is Lamb Fricassee. It includes crispy, browned lamb pieces, juicy beef stock and a lovely egg - so savoury! Don't forget, we need a perfect dessert to follow a rich and hearty lamb dish: fried dough balls. Joanna shows us her tricks for making them perfectly warm and crispy.

programme.title: Spencer's Big 30
programme.desc: Host Spencer Watts cooks up a delicious Greek feast in around 30 minutes, for under 30 dollars.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S03 : E23 Olives: The Most Useful Ingredient
programme.desc: Is there anything more Greek than olives? Host Joanna Chery shows us how versatile the olive really is by cooking up four diverse Greek dishes. To start, a rich, baked-to-perfection Olive Bread loaded with strong, slightly fruity black Kalamata olives. She then prepares a refreshing Greek Village Salad full of seasonal vegetables, creamy feta, and plump juicy olives tossed in extra virgin olive oil. And guess what? It pairs great with fried Olive Bread! Then, Joanna switches it up with wonderful green olives - the star in her delicious stuffing for Apricot and Feta-Stuffed Chicken Thighs. Finally, we're graced with a unique dessert - Saint Fanourios Cake. Joanna adds metaxa (Greek brandy), sweet dried apricots, and luscious olive oil for a moist dessert.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: From Canada to Greece, CombiNATION Plates always covers lots of ground! Kicking off, host Bianca Osbourne wows with ubERS-Canadian Roasted Venison Loin, yummy Fiddlehead Pancakes and sweet-tart Cranberry sauce. Next, enjoy a scenic Mediterranean vacation on a plate with her completely new approach to Greek Salad, taken up a notch or two with tasty seared Albacore Tuna! This episode's 'common ingredient' is lamb shank; check out two wildly creative re- inventions; first, of Canadian TourtieÌ€re, and then, Greek Dolmades. For a final recipe, a dessert fit for a lumberjack or a Greek god! Oka Saganaki with McIntosh Apple Butter and Maple Loukoumades; made with nutty Canadian Oka cheese, fried crisp, flambeÌed with Ouzo, then dusted with dried raspberry powder and maple sugar flakes. 'Opa!' meets Oka!

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Winters in Greece can get chilly, so fun host Joanna Chery warms us up with some hearty Greek dishes. First, she rolls up some tender Meatballs in a Lemon-Egg Sauce featuring a secret ingredient: rice (shh!). Then, she cooks a vegetarian stew that's packed with tasty artichokes, soft-boiled potatoes, and fragrant dill - great for a cool spring night. To finish, she makes a famous Greek dish called Moussaka. Traditionally eaten at Sunday dinner, this dish emulates the warmth of friends and family. Although it's a two part process - it's packed with layered vegetables, a hearty meat sauce and a creamy béchamel on top - it's so worth it!

programme.title: VegHeadz
programme.desc: Chef Pino Di Cerbo leaves no leaf behind in this exciting episode! Things kick off with a fresh salad full of crunchy cabbage and kale, topped with a mango vinaigrette. Then Pino gets wild with dolmades, grape leaves stuffed with wild rice and sweet caramelized onions. Next-up, French fries get friendly with foliage, served with a pile of fried herbs and homemade herb mayo for dipping. In his final creation, Pino reaches for the rainbow...of Swiss chard, that is! The colourful leaves get layered over creamy gorgonzola and puff pastry for a tart that will have you going back for more!

programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc: Golden Fries, a food truck venture founded by Jesse Teasdale and his wife, has become a popular spot at Bluesfest Ottawa. The truck, which started as a one-woman operation, quickly gained traction and now sees massive crowds, even requiring early gate openings for events like the Foo Fighters' performance. The menu highlights a classic poutine, made with fresh-cut fries, squeaky cheese curds, and rich gravy, as its top-selling item. The video captures various attendees raving about the quality and taste of the food, emphasizing the truck's commitment to using local, high-quality ingredients. Additionally, the video showcases the preparation and dedication that goes into running the truck, from early morning setups to handling large orders for bands and their crews. The narrative underscores the community spirit and the joy of sharing delicious food at live events.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 Busiest Time of the Year

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Customer Complaints"
programme.desc: Can two expats cope with their customer complaints? After a blocked drain threatened their future, have the owners of a Spanish seafood restaurant turned things around?

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "Their Adventure Begins"
programme.desc: Two adrenaline junkies that love nothing more than off road adventure motor biking. And they’re off on their most epic journey ever, to Argentina.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "Broken Bike"
programme.desc: Rob and Dave are pushed to their limits. Fighting through the rough ride across the scorching sand dunes littered with shrubbery Rob is unable to continue.

programme.title: Foodwise S2 - "Haikou"
programme.desc: Welcome to Haikou, also known as the Coconut City! Join Tianran experiencing the culinary culture and urban character of this tropical paradise. From light and sweet coconut chicken hotpot to refreshing herbal desserts and spicy rice soup.

programme.title: Foodie Adventures with Ash Pollard S1 - "Thailand - Beyond Bangkok"
programme.desc: Venturing off the tourist trail in search of authentic Pad Thai, Ash recreates her discoveries for former footballer Dane Swan.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Donsol, Philippines"
programme.desc: Disaster and triumph set this show apart. The brothers start out with a near death boat disaster in the southern Philippine Sea but bounce back and end up attaining their goal of reaching Donsol village, the whale shark capitol of the world.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Ryozenji Temple Shikoku, Japan"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Ryozenji Temple Shikoku, Japan
programme.desc: In this episode the brothers shun the more famous areas, Tokyo and Kyoto, and head to the isolated, ancient island of Shikoku. Their route is the ancient 88 Temple Zen pilgrimage circuit.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Cape Breton Island, Canada"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Cape Breton Island, Canada
programme.desc: By pick-up truck, the brothers route is the culturally and geographically rich island of Cape Breton and the Cabot Trail. Lobster fishing, hooking, moose sightings, Bingo, Scottish ceilidhs, Mi'kmaq drum session, it's all happening in this episode.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Charleroi"
programme.desc: Local exploring in industrial Charleroi, brings Cody to abandoned factories and an unknown spot full of colorful graffiti. An old casino awaits to be explored.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S1 - "KINA CREW"
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri is in Wellington with his dive team, the ‘Kina Crew’. The boys hit the west and southern coastlines to collect kai moana ahead of their annual ‘AGM’.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S1 - "WILD RAM + WEKA"
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri is in the Chatham Islands hunting wild ram and weka with one of the locals known as Big Jase.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S1 - "HAPUKA + FLOUNDER"
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri is in the Chatham Islands meeting up with local, Floyd Prendeville, who takes Piri spear fishing for Hapuka and drifting for flounder.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Dullstroom Highlands"
programme.desc: Xander and his team drive eleven hours to Dullstroom, a quaint town where fishing and drinking prevails. Across the pond, Adam’s desire to participate with Xander and his crew takes him all the way to the grocery store.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Panorama"
programme.desc: On opposite sides of the world, Adam and a member of the South African crew each attempt to conquer their fears.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "Into the Bush"
programme.desc: As Xander and his crew travel into the bush, they discover South Africa’s most beautiful qualities: national parks, safaris, and magnificent wildlife.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 The Honeymoon is Over

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - "The Spiritual Adventure"
programme.desc: Fleeing the hard monsoon rains, Jonathan seeks refuge with hot cups of java in the rolling hills of India’s coffee country and in the peaceful energy of India’s largest Tibetan community.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - "Kerala Kaleidoscope"
programme.desc: Jonathan hangs out with a group of fisherman that utilizes the ancient Chinese fishing nets designed in the time of Kublai khan. He attends a Kathakali dance academy and gets ready for center stage with an elaborate 3 hour makeup process.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - "Season 1 “Best of”"
programme.desc: Jonathan is back in India to host a special episode which explores his vast archive of experiences throughout India. Jonathan also reveals an exclusive insight into the inner workings of the show, how everything is put together and behind the scenes.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "Sri Lanka: Legends of Ceylon"
programme.sub-title: S06 : E06 Sri Lanka: Legends of Ceylon
programme.desc: Jonathan tracks ancient myths across Sri Lanka, unearthing sobering tsunami stories, hidden lighthouses, and unique local beverages.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "Sri Lanka: Footsteps of Ravana"
programme.sub-title: S06 : E07 Sri Lanka: Footsteps of Ravana

programme.title: The Light of Western Stars
programme.desc: Knights of the sage-brush roar across the plains in this western drama from Harry Sherman Productions. Victor Jory ( Papillon, Gone With The Wind), stars as a ranch foreman wrongly arrested for murder. The memorable cast includes Tom Tyler (Stage Coach, Adventures of Captain Marvel), plus Noah Beery Jr (The Rockford Files) and in one of his earliest feature roles, Alan Ladd (The Blue Dahlia, Shane).

programme.title: Riders of the Deadline
programme.desc: The 50th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy films finds Hoppy in a vengeful mood. When his good friend Tim Mason is unjustly sent to jail and then killed when trying to escape, Hoppys bitterness gets him drummed out of the Texas Rangers. With the help of his pals California Carson and Jimmy Rogers, he sets out to expose the real culprits and clear Tims name. The usual cast is here, including William Boyd as Hoppy, plus Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers, and in one of his earliest roles, Robert Mitchum.

programme.title: High Lonesome
programme.desc: A young drifter is suspected of murder in this stirring production from writer/director Alan Le May (best known for writing The Searchers). John Drew Barrymore stars as Cooncat, a troubled young man who has to steal to survive. With no friends in West Texas, he falls in with some bad customers who involve him in some terrible crimes. The strong cast includes Chill Wills, Jack Elam, and John Archer, with cinematography by Oscar winner W. Howard Greene.

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cyclone Tom Saunders starts a ruckus in a Chinese laundry and has to go before a judge. Unable to pay his fine, he is bailed out by a local cattle rancher and agrees to do 30 days' work for him. It's not too long before he becomes enmeshed in a war between rustlers and outlaws.

programme.title: The Gunman from Bodie
programme.desc: The Rough Riders, a popular group that thrilled audiences in the early 1940s, are after a gang of rustlers in this B-western from Hollywood's Poverty Row. Starring Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, and Raymond Hatton, this movie features everything from lawmen going undercover to the Rough Riders looking after an orphaned baby! Also, be on the lookout for the beautiful Christine McIntyre, who would go on to appear in several of the Three Stooges shorts for Colombia Pictures.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Ranch
programme.desc: Flagg is relocating flood victims to Gunsmoke Ranch. The Three Mesquiteers know Flagg to be a crook and try to warn them. They ignore the warning and improve the land only to find that it has been condemned for a new dam.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: A cavalry officer sympathetic to the wronged Sioux tribe fixes a meeting between Chief Sitting Bull and President Grant but a dishonest Indian Agent and a hateful General Custer test the Sioux's patience, threatening to derail the peace-talks. Directed and co-written by Sidney Salkow; starring Dale Robertson, Mary Murphy, J. Carrol Naish. Also, look for legendary character actor Iron Eyes Cody as Crazy Horse.

programme.title: Song of Arizona
programme.desc: This Roy Rogers adventure finds Gabby Whitaker (Gabby Hayes) running a ranch for wayward boys. One of the boys uses stolen money to help Gabby pay off his debts, but things unravel when the boys father, a notorious outlaw named King Blaine, is murdered; the rest of the Blaine gang show up at Gabbys looking for the loot! Director Frank McDonald works with a fine cast, including Dale Evans, Lyle Talbot, and of course, Roys beloved horse Trigger.

programme.title: Hands Across The Border
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures western about horse breeders vying for a contract with the U.S. Army. The cast also includes such favorites as Onslow Stevens and Guinn Big Boy Williams, while songs include Hey Hey (It's a Great Day), Dreaming to Music, and The Girl with the High Button Shoes. For movie buffs: The music for the title song, Hands Across the Border, was composed by none other than Hoagy Carmichael!

programme.title: Public Cowboy No. 1
programme.desc: Gene Autry and Smiley Burnette are back, and this time theyre dealing with some very modern thinking rustlers. These new criminals have taken up the latest technologies to outsmart the authorities, including shortwave radios and airplanes! Can Gene and Smiley get em? You bet! Songs include The West Aint What It Used To Be, I Got the HeebieJeebie Blues, and The Defective Detective from Brooklyn. Gene also gets romantic when he sings, I Picked up the Trail when I Found You...

programme.title: Under Western Stars
programme.desc: Roy Rogers debuts in his starring role as the likable cowboy sent to Congress with a mission: let Washington know about the suffering of farmers in the wake of America's 1930s Dustbowl. Enjoy the singing cowboy in his first starring role, rubbing shoulder with politians, going up against greedy executives, and representing a whole people group you'll see why Rogers became a national icon! Frog Millhouse: Smiley Burnett. Elanore Fairbanks: Carol Hughes. John Fairbanks: Guy Usher. Plus music and singing from the Maple City Four. (The song Dust was nominated for an Academy Award!) Directed by Joe Kane.

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures feature about the hunt for silver in a deserted ghost town. Songs include 'Colorado Joe' and 'Everything's Going My Way'. Plus, look for Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher. Film buffs should look for silent screen foil James Finlayson, a familiar face from various Keystone Cop comedies, as the local sheriff.

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Theres trouble out west! Its the Civil War and the Union needs troops back east to defend itself. Roy Rogers stars as Lieutenant Jerry Burke, who is sent to investigate why the returning troops are being stalled in Colorado. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Pauline Moore, and Milburn Stone, this film is action packed with a turn you wont see coming!

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trailblazer
programme.desc: Daniel Boone (Bruce Bennett) battles Shawnee warriors as he leads a band of settlers into Kentucky in this frontier potboiler from Albert C. Gannaway Productions. Made at the height of Hollywood's fascination with pioneer days, the film also stars Lon Chaney Jr. as Chief Blackfish, and country singer Faron Young as a handsome young suitor for Boone's daughter. There's plenty of action and danger here as the Shawnee are convinced that Boone is trying to steal their land. But Boone is ready, not even fearing death by tomahawk. It isn't how you die, Boone says. It's what you live for.

programme.title: Rawhide
programme.desc: Baseball superstar Gehrig is one of several ranchers being coerced by a bunch of bandits. His sister and her lawyer/lover organize the ranchers. Directed by Ray Taylor; starring Smith Ballew, Gehrig, Evelyn Knapp. Talk about stunt casting! Gehrig was a New York Yankees star who was nearing the end of his career, but one of the biggest sports stars in the country. In the movie he plays a variation of himself, as Lou Gehrig, a retired baseball player who takes up ranching. Lou expects to relax on his ranch but quickly joins other ranchers in a fight to protect their properties.

programme.title: Yellowneck
programme.desc: Location shooting in the Florida Everglades add to this dramatic tale of five Confederate deserters trying to get to Cuba. First, they must overcome snake bites, unfriendly Seminoles, and their own conflicts with each other. How many of the five will actually make it out alive? Lin McCarthy, Stephen Courtleigh, and Berry Kroeger star in this little known example of 1950s independent filmmaking.

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this vintage western. He and George Gabby Hayes strike it rich with a gold mine, only to find their lives complicated by women and crooked officials. Things get even messier when the good guys are framed for murder! Its all action here, particularly since legendary stuntman Yakima Cannut stars as one of the films heavies. Who will win the fight over the gold and the girl? Directed by Robert N. Bradbury for Monogram Pictures. Also starring Barbara Sheldon. (The film was also known as Gold Strike River.)

programme.title: Wagon Trail
programme.desc: The son of Sheriff Clay Hartley, of the frontier town Elder, has gotten into bad company and hangs out with an outlaw gang in which, Collins, owner of the Golden Rule Saloon, is the secret head. Sheriff Hartley suspects him, but has been unable to gather the needed evidence. Collins instructs his gang, including young Hartley, to hold up the stagecoach on its return trip from Missionary Flats and take the cargo of gold dust it is carrying. Sheriff Hartley is notified of the planned holdup by one of his deputies who has been spying on Collins, and organizes a posse. A deputy-sheriff is killed in the ensuing gunfight between the lawmen and the outlaws, but Deputy Joe Larkin, pursues and captures Clay Hartley Jr. The latter is quickly tried and convicted of the killing of the deputy, and sentenced to be hung. Sheriff Hartley has only a few hours to prove his son was not the killer. He enlists the aid of Collins' step-daughter, Joan, who is in love with Hartley's son.

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: Dad Longworth robs a Mexican bank, takes the loot, and leaves his partner Rio to be captured. However, Rio escapes capture and searches for Dad in California.

programme.title: The Deadly Companions
programme.desc: An unholy alliance! Marking the feature film debut of one of Hollywoods most influential and widely referenced auteur directors, Sam Peckinpah, The Deadly Companions centers on a redemptive journey to escort a funeral procession through dangerous Indian Territory. Featuring fine work from a top-notch cast that includes the inimitable Maureen OHara at the height of her illustrious career, Peckinpahs first foray into film provides a promising glance into the energetic and violent nature of his iconic later works.

programme.title: Last of the Clintons
programme.desc: Icon of early talking pictures, Harry Carey (Red River), portrays the rugged Trigger Carson, a noble cowboy who infiltrates an outlaw gang in order to expose their rackets. Ordered to kidnap a young girl, his identity is revealed and he is forced to fight his way out of the gang and back to safety. Already 56 by the time he signed on to do this and a series of Westerns for Berke Productions, the stately Carrey (who netted an Oscar nomination four years later) was widely lauded at the time for adding a great deal of maturity and respectability due to his undeniable presence and strong performances.

programme.title: Neath Canadian Skies
programme.desc: It's the mounties versus claim jumpers in this drama from Golden Gate Pictures. Based on an action-packed novel by James Oliver Curwood and directed by B. Reeves Maynard (Undersea Kingdom, The Phantom Empire), the film features an outstanding cast of Poverty Row regulars, including Russell Hayden, Inez Cooper, Cliff Nazarro, I. Stanford Jolley, and Kermit Maynard. For movie buffs: Cinematographer Marcel Le Picard began his career in the silent era and finished with exactly 200 credits!

programme.title: Red Ryder: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
programme.desc: Red Ryder encounters bandits trying to hold up the stagecoach carrying the owner of the Devil's Hole newspaper, Libby Brooks and her brother Gerry. Red successfully drives off the attackers but becomes embroiled in further conflict, leading to a duel that nearly claims his life.

programme.title: Fighting Fury
programme.desc: A THRILLING TALE OF REVENGE AND REDEMPTION! Based on the story Triple Cross for Danger by the widely lauded Western author Walter J. Coburn, Fighting Fury is a thrilling take on the Western revenge drama. Portraying both a father and his son, star of silent and sound cowboy adventure films, Jack Hoxie (Trouble Busters, Law and Lawless) exudes the classic American rustic charm that still defines the genre. The film spins the yarn of Clay Hill Jr. (Hoxie), a Spanish-American boy raised by a Mexican servant who vows bloody vengeance on three malicious ranchers after they murder his parents and turn his life upside down. Featuring fine supporting performances from genre heavies Helen Holmes, Buck Conners and Western mainstay Fred Kohler.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: Ablaze with guns and guts and glory! Randolph Scott headlines as a star studded cast in this yarn about battling homesteaders. Director Edwin L. Marin (Tall in the Saddle) spins this dramatic post-Civil War tale that takes place in the legendary cow town of Abilene, Kansas, coaxing fine performances from the likes of Ann Dvorak, Edgar Buchanan, Thonda Fleming, and Lloyd Bridges. Saddle up and hang on!

programme.title: Shine on Harvest Moon
programme.desc: Jackson and his gang are cattle rustlers holed up in Jackson Hole Wyoming. Roy's partner Brower was once Jackson's partner and is now suspected of being in cahoots with him. Someone is tipping off Jackson as to the cattle's whereabouts and when Roy learns who it is he has a plan to trap Jackson and clear his partner. Starring Roy Rogers, Lynne Roberts, and Myrtle Wiseman as 'Lulu Belle. Directed by Joseph Kane.

programme.title: Days of Jesse James
programme.desc: Famed American western actor and singer Roy Rogers once again plays himself in this Jesse James tale that's a twist on the familiar formula. When he is summoned to bring Jesse to justice after the known villain is suspected of a bank robbery, Rogers soon discovers that Jesse has been framed and that the owner of the bank has robbed his own bank posing as Jesse. Fast-paced and fun, this classic Roy Rogers western directed by Joseph Kane (Dakota) features a whole host of original songs sung by the great Rogers himself.

programme.title: Colorado Sundown
programme.desc: Murder among ranchers is the subject of this Republic Pictures drama. Starring such names as Rex Allen, Slim Pickins, and Chester Clute, this feature was directed by William Whitney. For Trivia Buffs: At one time Whitney was known as the youngest director in Hollywood, having been hired by the newly formed Republic Pictures at the tender age of 21.

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: Fred Scott plays a lawman who goes undercover to expose a dangerous gang of criminals in this action-packed drama. He also has time to sing three songs: Cactus Pete, Gonna Ride, and Heres Romance. Screenwriter Fred Myton would go on to write such offbeat features as Nabonga, and Border Phantom.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: What happens when Abraham Lincoln himself comes to New Mexico to discuss a treaty with Native American chief Acoma (Ted de Corsia)? Can the hotbed of emotions be quieted by cavalry Captain Hunt (Lew Ayres)? Or will the Captains superiors insist on provoking with the native tribe? Find out what happens in this fictional tale packed with action from 1951!

programme.title: Enemy of the Law
programme.desc: Tex Ritter stars in this western drama about a man who goes undercover to befriend a convict believed to have stolen a shipment of government gold. Also starring Guy Wilkerson as Panhandle Perkins, this offering from Hollywoods Poverty Row features the usual fistfights and entertaining storyline that made these modestly budgeted features well worth watching. Songs include Teach Me To Forget and You Will Have to Pay both sung by Tex!

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: Pancho Gomez kidnaps Don Roberto and his daughter, Tonita for ransom. Can an undercover lawman named Gun Smith save the pair, or will he be caught himself?! Smith gets a job in Gomez's camp supposedly to repair their guns. Instead he fixes the guns so they will misfire. When Gomez refuses to let him go, he sends his horse for the Sheriff! This campy western from 1931 stars Lane Chandler and is sure to keep you enthralled from beginning to end. Directed by Armand Schaefer; starring Marie Quillan and Walter Miller.

programme.title: Six Gun Trail
programme.desc: Legendary cowboy star Tim McCoy stars as Captain William Carson, who along with his sidekick Magpie does battle with jewel thieves. Its an actionfilled drama of the West, with plenty of blazing guns and heman adventure! There are a couple of songs, too, including Moon Over the Plains but they arent sung by Tim McCoy. He was too darned tough to sing! Also starring Nora Lane, Ben Corbet; directed by Sam Newfield.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: He Dared Death In The Outlaw's Lair! John Travers (John Wayne) takes on a mysterious gang leader known as The Shadow in this vintage western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Director/writer Robert N. Bradbury (Blue Steel, Riders of Destiny) gets the best of a remarkable cast that includes George Gabby Hayes. Of interest to film buffs is that the feature was shot in various California locations by Oscar winning cinematographer Archie Stout (The Quiet Man).

programme.title: Raiders of Red Gap
programme.desc: Bob's Playin' A Mystery Hand... He's Marked For Death By Killer Bullets As Gunfire Echoes Over The Plains! After one of his ranch hands is killed when a gang attacks his ranch, Jim Roberts joins forces with his neighbor in an effort to fight off the Bennett Cattle Co., a company looking to rob them of their land. Things get increasingly dangerous as the company hires Butch Crane, a professional killer, to stop them. Directed by Sam Newfield (Racing Luck (1935), Go-Get-Em, Haines (1936)), Raiders of Red Gap stars Robert Livingston (The Three Mesquiteers (1936), Larceny on the Air (1937)) as Rocky (Lone Rider) Cameron and Al St. John (Billy the Kid Trapped (1942), Border Feud (1947)) as Fuzzy Q. Jones.

programme.title: Raiders of Old California
programme.desc: The end of the Mexican-American War finds a brazen U.S. Calvary captain and his men taking over a Spanish land grant. Albert C. Gannaway (The Badge of Marshall Brennan) directs an all-star cast including Jim Davis (Jock Ewing of Dallas), Arleen Whelan (Young Mr. Lincoln) and Lee Van Cleef (The Good, The Bad, and the Ugly). Also, look for appearances by legendary country & western stars Marty Robbins and Faron Young.

programme.title: The Fighting Westerner
programme.desc: A mining engineer tries to solve the murders of several heirs to a valuable radium mine in this western drama from Paramount Pictures. Stars include Charles Chic Sale, and in one of his early roles, Randolph Scott. This feature, also known as Rocky Mountain Mystery, was directed by Oscar winner Charles Barton, who would go on to direct several popular television shows, including Petticoat Junction and Family Affair...

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: A love story and a search for gold in the Valley of Death! Dubbed simple, powerful and dramatic by the New York Times on the date of its release, Death Valley is indeed an elegant depiction of love and deception in the American desert during the Gold Rush. In what was to be the final film of famed silent film director Paul Powell (Polyanna), a cast of mostly unknown actors produces uniformly excellent work. Lyrical and graceful, Powells film spins the tale of a young boy who finds love and gold, only to have it stolen from him.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
programme.desc: GENE AUTRY COMES ROARING OUT OF THE SKIES...to save the forests from an outlaw lumber ring! When ex forest ranger Gene tries to interfere with a gang destroying the timberland, hes framed for cattle-poisoning and set up for a murder charge. Yet, he still has time to sing some great cowboy songs, including Its My Lazy Day, and Hair of Gold. This is Gene Autry in a slightly different role, with some great footage filmed at Big Bear Valley and San Bernardino National Forest.

programme.title: Colorado Kid
programme.desc: Cowboy star Bob Steele (Valley of Hunted Men, The Trail Blazers) headlines this Poverty Row western drama. As the Colorado Kid, he's falsely arrested for murder and has to clear himself. The colorful cast includes Ernie Adams, Frank LaRue, and Horace Murphy, with direction by Sam Newfield (The Terror of Tiny Town, The Mad Monster).

programme.title: The Two Gun Man
programme.desc: Ken Maynard stars in this vintage western about ranchers under threat from hired gunmen. Director Phil Rosen, whose career dated back to working with Thomas Edison and included several Charlie Chan features, keeps the action hot with help from a strong ensemble, including Charles King, Murdock MacQuarrie, and a horse named Tarzan! Maynard plays Blackie Weed, a marshall going undercover to capture and arrest some cattle rustlers.He finds himself up against some very bad men, and he's soon framed for murder. Watch as Blackie blazes his way to vindication with a .45 in either hand and the flame of righteous anger in his eyes... Kitty: Nita Martin. Joe Kearney: Lafe McKee. Lem Tolliver: Tom London. Ranch Foreman: Walter Perry

programme.title: Young Bill Hickock
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars as the title character in this actionpacked feature from Republic Pictures. Starring Sally Payne as Calamity Jane, and Rogerss ongoing sidekick George Gabby Hayes, this twofisted saga relives some of Americas most colorful days, and also has time for a few musical numbers, including Up and Down the Prairie, and When the Shadows Fall Across the Rockies.

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: With Sitting Bull at the Spirit Lake Massacre
programme.desc: A long-thought-lost film finally surfaces after being unseen for over eight decades. Created and copyrighted by Sunset Productions in 1925 but not released until June 15, 1927, this silent epic features the superior Native American actor Chief Yowlachie (performing here under the name Chief Yowlache) as Sitting Bull. Other fine actors in the cast include the always popular Bryant Washburn and a young Bob Steele, who appears under his real name Bob Bradbury Jr. The story takes place in the 1860s or 1870s near Spirit Lake, Iowa. Settlements of whites are growing in that region but the Sioux Indians also have professed their interest in one such settlement. Chief Sitting Bull surveys the settlement at Spirit Lake from afar and with the advice of the Great Spirit vows to retake the land that belonged to his fathers.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Stoney and the son of the local Indian chief are attacked while escorting a gold shipment meant for the tribe. The nuggets are stolen, the Indian killed and Stoney is arrested for the murder and theft. With his partner in jail, Pat endeavors to learn who is behind the robbery and the previous thefts of tools and supplies meant for the Indians before the tribe returns to the warpath to avenge the death of their kinsman.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: In an episode called, Spring the Trap, desperado Lew Danning hid his stolen loot before dying. Pat disguises himself as the outlaw and slips into a lawless border town to gather clues from Lasker's gang of thieves. Suddenly Danning's sister shows up looking for her brother. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: In this episode, the scourge of the Southwest is a ruthless and devious killer known as the Sidewinder. When a hapless Cavalryman escorting the criminal falls victim to his tricks, Pat and Sonny set out to track him down and bring him in. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. This episode, Stolen Dynamite, stars Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan. In this episode, the G-men nab a beautiful spy.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 The President Who Came to Dinner
programme.desc: President of the railroad comes to visit the Shady Rest hotel with the intention to terminate the Cannonball's service. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Is There a Doctor in the Roundhouse
programme.desc: Railroad CEO Norman Curtis breaks the Cannonball's throttle lever, threatening the success of the Shady Rest Hotel's annual jamboree. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Norman Curtis: Roy Roberts. Directed by David Alexander.Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Courtship of Floyd Smoot
programme.desc: Kate's intentions are mistaken when she tries to help Floyd Smoot regain his confidence after being slighted by the woman he loves, a bride he had ordered by mail! Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Floyd Smoot: Rafe Davis.Directed by Sherman Marks. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Please Buy My Violets
programme.desc: Kate is forced to peddle cologne when Uncle Joe buys a bunch of cases with the money meant for window screens.Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: To everyones excitement, Boiler ODoul arrives in Diablo with the towns new steam fire engine. When the bank is robbed, Annie must think of a creative way to smoke out the criminals. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie faces off against dangerous twin sisters, Dana and Jana Matthews. Annie is fast with a gun, but is she fast enough to take on a duo known as The Trigger Twins? Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. programme.desc: The outlaw Jesse James and his friend are on the run from the law when he is wrongly accused of leading the historic 1876 Northfield, Minnesota bank robbery. programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: Loser's End

Other stars include Tina Menard as the woman who helps him along the way, and Elias Lazoroff as the daring Don Carlos. Perrin (Jaws of Justice, The Apache Kid's Escape), was a familiar face in low budget westerns, his career spanning back to the silent era.

programme.title: Range War
programme.desc: William Boyd returns in the 25th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy adventures. Also, look for Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Britt Wood as Speedy McGinnis. It's a great, action-packed adventure from director Leslie Selander (Flight to Mars, Riders of the Range), and further proof that no one pushes Hoppy around and gets away with it!

programme.title: Whats On - 7 - Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.sub-title: Whats On - 7 - Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

programme.title: Gold Cuisine EP 4
programme.desc: Chryso Lefou makes a light and tasty Mediterranean dish with fresh pasta, colourful mint pesto, and juicy cherry tomatoes. She makes crispy fried almond fingers (Dactyla) for dessert, which adds a nutty, sweet finish. A delectable blend of decadent treats and savoury, fresh flavours.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Barcelona
programme.desc: Barcelona, Spain, is a city close to Malini's heart. Returning after her student years, she retraces old steps to see how the city has changed. Barcelona, one of Europe’s most visited cities, still holds centuries-old charm. Malina's old haunts include El Gòtic, Sant Antoni, Passeig de Gràcia, and Barceloneta. visits Gaudí’s iconic Casa La Pedrera, and discovers the new wave of creative tapas restaurants in El Raval, a once run-down quarter now bursting with energy.

programme.title: Made in Med: Legacy of stone sculpture
programme.sub-title: Made in Med: Legacy of stone sculpture
programme.desc: From rough blocks of stone to expressive works of art, Reuben Mallia reveals the patience and skill behind traditional Mediterranean stone carving. Fadi steps into his world to discover how simple tools, careful craftsmanship, and countless hours of work can bring solid rock to life.

programme.title: Rick Steves Europe

programme.title: Opera - Salome
programme.desc: The 87th Festival of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino opens with Richard Strauss's Salome, conducted by Alexander Soddy. Directed by Emma Dante, this new production features Lidia Fridman as Salome, Anna Maria Chiuri as Herodias, and Nikolai Schukoff as Herodes. The performance blends Strauss's intense musical drama with a fresh and dynamic staging.

programme.title: Whats On - 9 - Trade, Exhibitions and Unique Experiences
programme.sub-title: Whats On - 9 - Trade, Exhibitions and Unique Experiences
programme.desc: There is a unique energy that takes over the Mediterranean as the summer heat begins to build. This week, we are bypassing the usual tourist routes to find the heartbeat of the region through its most spectacular festivals. Imagine the sun setting over a lake in Tuscany as the Puccini Festival opens its 72nd season with the powerful melodies of Turandot. programme.desc: In May 2021, pianist Alexander Malofeev joined conductor Fabio Luisi and the Orchestra Sinfonica Nazionale della Rai for a performance at Turin's Auditorium RAI Arturo Toscanini. The program featured Franz Liszt's Piano Concerto No. 1 in E-flat major and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 6 in B minor, "Pathétique." Malofeev's interpretation of Liszt's concerto was particularly noted for its expressive depth and technical prowess.

programme.title: Power Metal Journey
programme.desc: Embark on a heroic quest fueled by soaring vocals, blistering guitar solos, and triumphant symphonic melodies. This playlist delivers high-energy anthems, epic fantasy tales, and pure, unstoppable speed metal glory.

programme.title: Metal Detector
programme.desc: Look no further! This is the right place for everything heavy. Your quest has ended so, lean back, turn up that sound system to a solid 11 and enjoy the ride. You have been warned…

programme.title: Death Metal Blasts
programme.desc: Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

programme.title: Right Up Your Alley
programme.desc: As you found your way to our sophisticated TV channel, these music videos should hopefully satisfy your need for cool new Metal- & Rock content. Enjoy and let your friends know! Remember, we’re in this together.

programme.title: Symphonic Metal Epicness
programme.desc: Grand orchestral arrangements meet crushing heavy metal in a majestic display of power. Featuring operatic vocals, sweeping strings, and cinematic soundscapes, this collection delivers pure, dramatic drama on an epic scale.

programme.title: New Rock And Metal Videos For You
programme.desc: Stay ahead of the curve with the freshest drops from the global underground. From world premieres to the latest studio masterpieces, we’ve gathered the newest sonic assaults in one place. If it’s loud and new, it’s here.

programme.title: Where Heavy Music Lives
programme.desc: Your official gateway to the underground. Discover your first distorted riff or find a circle of peers who "get it." Welcome to the neighborhood—it’s loud, it’s proud, and there’s always room for one more.

programme.title: Metalcore Madness
programme.desc: Welcome to the ultimate pit. Metalcore Madness brings you the visual pulse of metalcore and deathcore—packed with blistering solos, heavy breakdowns, and raw energy. Turn it up, open the pit, and let the madness take over!

programme.title: Progressive Metal Laboratory
programme.desc: A cerebral explosion of technical wizardry and complex structures. Dive into a fusion of dizzying riffs, odd time signatures, and soaring melodies as masters of their craft redefine metal's limits in this experimental sound lab.

programme.title: Bay Area Godfathers
programme.desc: Info not available

programme.title: Night Time Metal
programme.desc: The sun is down, the filters are off, and the real chaos begins. Brace yourself for the raw, uncensored side of the scene too heavy for daylight. This is the unfiltered truth of the underground. Adult ears only.

programme.title: Bay Area Godfathers II
programme.desc: Info not available

programme.title: For Metalheads Only
programme.desc: Leave the rock anthems at the door—this is 100% pure steel. We’ve dialed the distortion to eleven for a lineup strictly for the heavy-duty fans. No compromises, no fillers, just total sonic devastation.

programme.title: Alternative Metal Paths
programme.desc: Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

programme.title: Finnish Metal Special
programme.desc: From the frozen North comes a sound of haunting melodies and raw intensity. Dive into Finland’s finest, where melancholic atmospheres meet the power of the thousand lakes. It’s a masterclass in darkness and ice-cold riffs.

programme.title: Folk Metal Forest Feast
programme.desc: Raise your horns and join the battle! A high-energy mix of crushing metal riffs, accordion melodies, and epic pagan chants. Step into the ancient woods for a wild night of acoustic tradition meets heavy metal fury.

programme.title: Mouk

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag - Brilberen
programme.desc: Kom erachter wat brilberen eten en wie de vijand van de beer is.

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag - Chimpansees
programme.desc: Chimpansees zijn erg slim en Saskia van Dierenpark Amersfoort vertelt hoe de apen deze puzzels kunnen oplossen.

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag - Dieren op transport
programme.desc: Weet jij hoe een dierentuin aan zijn dierbewoners komt? DierenPark Amersfoort werkt samen met bijna 350 Europese dierentuinen. We begeleiden de verhuizing van de leeuwenwelpen en vertellen hoe de verhuizing van zulke roofdieren gaat.

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag - Flamingo
programme.desc: Dierverzorger Paul beantwoordt al jullie dierenvragen, dus kom erachter waarom flamingo’s roze zijn of wat flamingo’s eten. Paul laat zien hoe flamingo’s met hun snavel voedsel eten en ik zet het eten voor de flamingo’s klaar.

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag - Hyena
programme.desc: Samen met dierverzorger Rob ontdek ik hoe snel hyena’s kunnen rennen en waarom hyena’s lachen. En wist je dat hyena’s hele sterke kaken hebben en zelfs door botten kunnen bijten?

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag - Kleuren en Patronen
programme.desc: In DierenPark Amersfoort kom je dieren tegen met allerlei bijzondere kleuren en patronen. Een tijger heeft strepen, de kameleon kan van kleur veranderen en papegaaien hebben heel felle kleuren. Maar waarom hebben dieren verschillende kleuren en patronen?

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag - Leeuwen
programme.desc: Samen met dierverzorger Esther geven we de leeuwen eten, leggen we herfstblaadjes in het verblijf en controleren we of leeuw Zaila op een gezond gewicht is. En vinden leeuwen wortels lekker? We proberen het uit!

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag - Olifanten
programme.desc: We kijken mee bij de training van de olifanten en Rob legt uit waarom we dat doen. Ondertussen maken we het verblijf klaar voor een nieuwe dag en vullen we de vijver zodat de olifanten kunnen zwemmen.

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag - Poep & ZOO
programme.desc: Ontdek alles over dierenpoep in DierenPark Amersfoort! Met dierverzorger Vera gaan we naar de neushoorns, zebra’s, leeuwen en olifanten. Vera vertelt alles over wat deze dieren eten, hoeveel zij poepen en hoe de dierenpoep wordt opgeruimd.

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag - Reptielen
programme.desc: Wij bezoeken het Honderdduizend Dierenhuis van DierenPark Amersfoort. Hier wonen slangen, leguanen, de kameleon en zelfs de vogelspin. Samen met dierverzorger Paul zorg ik voor het voedsel van alle reptielen en insecten.

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag - Rode Panda
programme.desc: Vandaag ga ik naar de rode panda’s van DierenPark Amersfoort! We halen bamboe en maken het verblijf klaar voor een nieuwe dag. Ik kijk mee bij de training van de panda’s door dierverzorger Mirthe om hen voor te bereiden op de grote verhuizing.

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag - Stokstaartjes
programme.desc: Vandaag bezoeken wij de stokstaartjes van DierenPark Amersfoort! Dierverzorger Esther maakt verrijking klaar voor de stokstaartjesgroep. Wat eten stokstaartjes en hoe communiceren deze dieren met elkaar?

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag - Tijgers
programme.desc: Wat eten de Siberische tijgers van DierenPark Amersfoort! Samen met dierverzorger Marc maak ik het verblijf klaar voor deze dieren. Ik kijk ook mee bij de training van de tijgers, super bijzonder!

programme.title: StoryZoo & Dirk Scheele

programme.desc: Mijn lievelingsinstrument! Ik heb een gitaar, met zes snaren. M’n handen gaan op en neer & ik schud met m’n haren.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.desc: Gargamel verzint een legende over de Heksensmurf om zo Grote Smurf en zijn vrienden in de val te lokken in zijn geheime schuilplaats in de bergen. Maar Grote Smurf schakelt Gargamel uit door middel van zijn eigen magie. En zo wordt de boze tovenaar terug gejaagd naar zijn kasteel.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 De Smurfen: Een Reuze Plaaggeest
programme.desc: De Smurfen ontdekken een “Reuze Plaaggeest” die weigert hun wensen te vervullen tot ze de toverspreuk zeggen. Jammer genoeg gaat Gargamel op zoek in zijn boeken. Hij vindt er de magische woorden “pompernikkel pikkel” waarmee de plaaggeest op pad wordt gestuurd om de Smurfen te vangen. Gargamel heeft zijn drie wensen opgebruikt waarna Grote Smurf de magische woorden uitroept. De plaaggeest moet doen wat Grote Smurf zegt. De Smurfen worden bevrijd, Gargamel komt in de rivier terecht en de plaaggeest moet voor altijd terug in de fles.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 De Smurfen: De Smurfen En De Krwakakrwa
programme.desc: Grote Smurf heeft een groeidrankje gemaakt. Het komt per ongeluk terecht in de bek van een vogeltje dat hierdoor verandert in een reusachtig wezen. Na lang nadenken, gebruikt Grote Smurf zijn verkleindrankje. De vogel wordt weer klein en alles is weer zoals het was in Smurfendorp.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 De Smurfen: Behekst, Bedrogen En Besmurft
programme.desc: De heks Hogatha verliest haar tovermedaillon in het Smurfenbos en overhaalt Gargamel om haar te helpen zoeken. Maar het is Smurfin die het medaillon vindt.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 De Smurfen: De Smurfenkleurenbril
programme.desc: Knutselsmurf geeft Smurfin een roze toverbril kado waardoor ze alles mooier ziet. Met deze bril hoopt hij haar hart te veroveren. Maar de bril drijft de Smurfin in de handen van Gargamel. Gelukkig komt er net een hongerige reus op bezoek die de bril opzet en zodoende in Gargamel een lekker hapje ziet. Smurfin kan ontsnappen...

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E51 De Smurfen: De Ene Goeie Dienst Is De Andere Waard
programme.desc: Knutselsmurf heeft Klungelsmurf gered van een verschrikkelijk lot. Klungesmurf belooft zijn redder eeuwige toewijding en stelt zich volledig ten zijne dienst….met vervelende gevolgen. Klungels goede bedoelingen moeten gestopt worden voor er nog meer katastrofes gebeuren.

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
programme.desc: Hoe kan je het beste een galopwissel rijden? Britt en George laten het vandaag zien. Tijdens een proef moet je dit ook kunnen. Daarna gaat Britt weer lekker op Eve rijden! Het is namelijk een tijdje geleden. Eve heeft het de afgelopen maanden iets rustiger gehad. Britt laat jullie zien hoe ze het rijden weer oppakt met Eve.

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Paardenpraat TV: George pimpen
programme.desc: Britt heeft George omgetoverd tot Unicorn. Hij ziet er zo cool uit met zijn gekleurde manen en staart! Daarnaast laat Britt je zien hoe ze ervoor zorgt dat George altijd op zijn mooist voor de dag komt. Het is nog niet zo makkelijk om George wit te houden! Hopelijk gaat het haar lukken.

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Paardenpraat TV: Op George rijden zonder hoofdstel en zadel
programme.desc: Britt vond het heerlijk om lekker zonder zadel op Vito te rijden. Op George heeft ze nog niet zo vaak zonder zadel gereden! Britt en George blijven oefenen om steeds beter te worden. Eerst gaat Britt oefenen met George zonder zadel en op muziek, om George te laten wennen. Vervolgens gaat ze op George zonder hoofdstel rijden. Als dat maar goed gaat!

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Barbecue
programme.desc: Eerlijkheid. Soms doet ze wel eens iets wat misschien ‘stout’ is. Maar ze is wel altijd eerlijk. Ook zonder dat haar ouders op haar letten. En als ze een probleem veroorzaakt zal ze er alles aan doen om dat weer goed te maken.

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Warm!
programme.desc: Het dak van Naranjina’s huis is zo warm geworden dat ze er een eitje op bakt. De anderen zitten onder een boom in de schaduw op een ‘koele’ plek. Freddie zit in een boom/lantaarnpaal op wacht. Ondanks de schaduw heeft Faya het nog steeds te warm, zucht ze… Binnen is het echter nog warmer met de zon die onbarmhartig op het dak schijnt. En het water in de regenton is bijna verdampt. Hitte in de stad…

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Dokko's kies
programme.desc: De ijscoman rinkelt met zijn bel. Automatisch springt iedereen verlekkerd op. Naranjina haalt geld uit het potje ‘onvoorzien’ in haar kast vol met geldpotjes, ondanks tegenwerpingen van Lise. Ze koopt voor iedereen, zelfs voor Dokko, ijsjes. Dokko blaft het uit van de pijn als hij een hap neemt.

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers

programme.desc: Naranjina ziet haar stukgetrapte groentetuintje en maakt met een kwast en een stuk metaal een bord. Ze plant het bord met een doodshoofd erop bij een vertrapt groentetuintje: Pas op, verontreinigde grond! Ze hoopt dat Ruben haar tuintje nu met rust zal laten.

programme.desc: In deze tijd van het jaar worden veel dierenbaby’s geboren. De ooievaar is druk bezig met ze naar hun nest te dragen. Ze wordt het werk beu dus laat ze het aan Boes over om de dierenbaby’s te dragen. Maar nu moet Boes ervoor zorgen..
